$comment: mold_v0-219: the one registry of the shell's optional capabilities, each an on/off flag in the app's profile (profile.json `features`, {"<id>": true|false}). Read by src/features.ts (the server's gates), scripts/gen-packs.mjs (the console's pages and sidebar, web/src/config/features.generated.ts), the factory (.claude/scripts/lib/features.py: the app spec's `features`, the brief's `features.<id> = true|false` lines in ## Profile, `factory.py spec check`) and the factory board (plugins/factory-board). A capability is ON only when something asks for it (`requested_by`: a pack's declaration, or `always` for a profile toggle) AND its flag is not false. `default`: the flag's value when neither `features` nor a `legacy` key says: true where the capability was on whenever a pack declared it before this registry (so turning the flags on changes no existing app), false where it was an opt-in profile toggle. `legacy`: the profile key that said it before (still read; it and `features` must agree). `requires`: flags that must be on with it (`requires_any`: one of them). `quiet_off` (mold_v0-243): while off, the flag is left out of the build's generated files, so an app that never turns it on builds exactly what it built before the flag existed. Never edit an id: apps' state names them.

flags.label: Workspace credentials
flags.requested_words: a pack declares credential fields (pack.json credentials)
flags.about: Each workspace keeps its own credentials for the packs' runs (write-only, sealed with the workspace's key): the console's Credentials page (Settings › Credentials), /api/credentials, its OAuth connections (/api/credential-connections) and GitHub App installation (/api/github-app).
flags.off: No Credentials page or sidebar entry, and /api/credentials, /api/credential-connections and /api/github-app answer not found. Refused while a job kind needs a credential that is not optional (nobody could give it).

flags.label: Company email
flags.requested_words: a pack declares the company's own email (pack.json email: sender.allow or intake)
flags.about: A workspace's own sender (SMTP, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace) and mailboxes read into a record area: Settings › Email, /api/email, the email intake job and its MCP tools, Health's Email Delivery tab.
flags.off: No Settings › Email page or sidebar entry, /api/email answers not found, no mailbox is polled, no intake tool is listed, and every email goes out through the app's default sender.

flags.label: Scheduled alerts
flags.requested_words: a record area declares due dates (record_areas[].due), or a workspace area declares clocks (record_areas[].clocks, with record_clocks on): their reminders and escalation steps
flags.about: The daily due-date notices and their emails, and the clocks' reminders and escalation steps (an in-app notice, an email, a reassignment or a raised value): the Notices page and /api/notices.
flags.off: No due-date notice or email is posted and no clock step runs (clocks still show each record's deadline and status when record_clocks is on); no Notices page or sidebar entry, and /api/notices answers not found.

flags.label: Record clocks
flags.requested_words: a workspace record area declares clocks (record_areas[].clocks)
flags.about: Each record's deadlines: the clock check job, the records' `clocks` and `due` fields, the clock columns and Overdue filter, the record page's history, the Due soon card (/api/records/due-soon) and the clock MCP tools.
flags.off: No clock is computed or kept, no clock column, filter or history shows, the Due soon card is empty and no clock tool is listed; a metric or tab that counts by a clock is refused at build.

flags.label: Data audit trail
flags.requested_words: the app's profile (no pack declares it)
flags.about: Every read, change, reveal and export of a workspace's records: Billing's Access log tab, /api/audit/data, the read_audit_trail MCP tool, staff's /admin/access-log.
flags.off: Nothing is written, no route answers, no tab or page shows and no tool is listed.

flags.label: Platform audit trail
flags.requested_words: the app's profile (no pack declares it)
flags.about: Every API and MCP request and sign-in, and every staff action on an account: /admin/access-log, /api/audit/platform, the admin MCP's read_platform_trail.
flags.off: Nothing is written, no route answers, no page shows and no tool is listed.

flags.label: Chain and sign
flags.requested_words: the app's profile (no pack declares it)
flags.about: Signed checkpoints of the hash-chained audit trails (Ed25519 over Merkle roots): the ledger checkpoint job, /api/ledger/verify and /checkpoints, /.well-known/ledger-keys.json, the verify_audit_trail MCP tool and Settings › Signing. On, the app needs APP_LEDGER_SIGNING_KEY, which the factory makes (mold.json profile_secrets, lib/ledger_key.py: provision.py <app> --generate-secret APP_LEDGER_SIGNING_KEY; mold_v0-227).
flags.off: No checkpoint is signed, no route or well-known key answers and no tool is listed (the chain itself is always kept where entries are written).

flags.label: On-premises runners
flags.requested_words: a job kind declares private_network: true
flags.about: A workspace installs a runner inside its own network for the kinds that need it: /api/runners, /api/runner, the runners section of Credentials, staff's Runners tab.
flags.off: No runner route, page, tab or enrolment; every run is hosted.

flags.label: Developer surface
flags.requested_words: a pack declares developer_surface (in the app spec: kind embedded with a developer_surface block)
flags.about: The REST API at /v1, /openapi.json, scoped keys, client sessions, Standard Webhooks out and in, the SDKs, the developer console (Settings: API keys, Allowed origins, Webhooks, Integrations) and Health's Webhook Delivery tab. In the app spec `kind` stays the switch: kind embedded (with its developer_surface block) is what requests it; this flag only turns a declared surface off and must agree with kind.
flags.off: Nothing of it is mounted, no table is read, no event is queued and no page shows.

flags.label: Declarative checks
flags.about: Yes/no questions the records answer: /api/checks, /v1/checks, the check_<name> MCP tools, with their fallback rules (first_of) and percentage bucketing (bucket conditions; mold_v0-224/225/226), a client session's checks scopes and the onboarding's check tools.
flags.off: No check route answers and no check tool is listed.

flags.label: Encrypted fields
flags.requested_words: a record area's field declares encrypted: true
flags.about: Fields envelope-encrypted at rest, masked on every read, revealed on purpose: the reveal routes and MCP tools and the encrypted-field migration job.
flags.off: Refused at build while a pack declares an encrypted field (turning it off never stores a value in the clear); with none, nothing of it runs.

flags.label: Health history
flags.requested_words: a build without the session engine (no host pack owns products, scenarios, simulations and agent_sessions)
flags.about: Health › Status's graphs: a sample of the live checks every few minutes (health_samples), its scheduled job and GET /api/admin/onboarding/health/history.
flags.off: No sample is taken or kept and the job is not scheduled: Status keeps its live checks and headlines, and its graphs have no history (no sample in any bucket).

flags.label: Document previews
flags.requested_words: a record area's field of type file, or a field that previews its URL's document (preview: document)
flags.about: A record's documents as cards under its fields: GET /api/records/<area>/<key>/files (and staff's), each file's preview (PDF, images, text, sanitised HTML) or download, and the console's document cards.
flags.off: The file card routes answer not found and the console shows no document card; the files stay stored and the records keep their file fields.

flags.label: Workspace agent
flags.requested_words: the app's profile (no pack declares it)
flags.about: A long-lived agent a person talks to, run through a harness in the workspace's own run sandbox: its sessions, steering mid-run (guidance, approvals, pause, resume, stop), parking and crash recovery, its budgets and retention. /api/agent, the agent MCP tools, the top bar's agent icon (the brand's own, or a workspace owner's in Settings › Workspace agent, mold_v0-252) and /app/agent (staff: /admin/agent and the Workspace agent settings).
flags.off: No route answers, no tool is listed, no icon, page, Settings tab or setting shows, and no agent session can start; the generated files leave its flag out.

flags.label: Record page layouts
flags.requested_words: a record area's page layout (detail) or a field marked copyable
flags.about: A record's page laid out as its area declares (detail): a header with the title, a summary, coloured status badges, who added it and up to 8 facts; notices shown while a condition on the record holds; tabs of sections, each a card of field groups in 1, 2 or 3 columns with its own empty state; and copy buttons for the record's id, the page's link and each copyable field.
flags.off: Every record page is the one details card it always was (every field, then documents, deadlines, links and credentials); the layouts stay declared and checked, and the generated files leave them and the flag out.
